writeup: Woot has the Dometic 22 oz Sip Bottle in the Ocean color, new, for $19.99. Dometic's own site and Nomadic Supply both sell the exact same Ocean bottle (MPN 97000071447) for $39.99, so this is about half off. It's a double-wall vacuum insulated steel bottle with a built-in straw lid. Only two were left when we checked, with a limit of three per customer.
